Level 3 Site Walkthrough – 21 October 2026

Site walkthrough conducted on Level 3 with Sarah (Apex Concrete) on 21 October 2026. The Level 3 Zone B slab pour has been pushed to Thursday due to rain, and Sarah has confirmed the pump is booked for 7:00 am Thursday. Several safety issues were identified including a missing handrail and a blocked fire exit corridor.

Site & areas inspected
- Level 3 walked with Sarah (Apex Concrete).
- Level 2 east stair landing and Level 1 fire exit corridor also observed.

Progress observed
- Level 3 Zone B slab pour delayed to Thursday due to rain.
- Electrical rough-in approximately 80% complete on Level 3.

Defects / issues
- Level 2 east stair landing: permanent handrail missing; temporary barricade currently in place.
- Level 1 fire exit corridor: 2 pallets of blocks obstructing the corridor.

Safety observations
- Level 2 east stair landing – handrail absent; temporary barricade installed as interim measure.
- Level 1 fire exit corridor – 2 pallets of blocks blocking egress route; labourers directed to clear today.

Instructions given
- Sarah (Apex Concrete) to confirm pump booking for Zone B slab pour by 10:00 am tomorrow (22 October 2026) – subsequently confirmed: pump booked for 7:00 am Thursday.
- Labourers instructed to relocate pallets of blocks from Level 1 fire exit corridor today.

Decisions
- Level 3 Zone B slab pour rescheduled to Thursday due to rain.
- Pump for Level 3 Zone B slab pour confirmed booked by Sarah (Apex Concrete) for 7:00 am Thursday.

Action items
- Move 2 pallets of blocks obstructing Level 1 fire exit corridor. (Labourers), due 21 October 2026
- Install permanent handrail at Level 2 east stair landing.

Follow-ups
- Verify pallets have been cleared from Level 1 fire exit corridor by end of day.
- Confirm target completion date for Level 3 electrical rough-in.
- Confirm programme impact of Zone B pour delay.
